infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Cortex Construct uses the camera to capture site photos and evidence for construction records.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Cortex Construct accesses selected photos to attach evidence to projects and site records.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Cortex Construct saves exported reports and project evidence when you choose to save them.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Cortex Construct uses your location to tag site check-ins and progress photos when you choose to record them.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cortex Construct uses the microphone when you record voice notes for site records.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Cortex Construct to attach selected site photos and evidence to construction records.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Cortex Construct to capture site photos and evidence.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Cortex Construct to record voice notes for site records.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Cortex Construct to tag site check-ins and progress photos with location when you choose to record them.
